scope: Create and verify the disposable cable guide files and record a short project note.
constraints: One editable mesh with an open channel along its depth.
Aim for 50 × 24 × 15 mm outer dimensions, an 8 mm channel opening, and ground level at 0 mm.
decisions: Deliver a Blender source and export only the guide to GLB.
Use a clean scene for the round-trip check.

evidence.limits: Applies to the fictional cable guide only.

acceptance: Compare dimensions within 0.1 mm, mesh count, and triangle count after reimport.
